disagreements.finding: New exact-current finding: GearboxV2Decision carries checkpoint_required, receiver_ack_required, verification_gate, real_experience_claim_allowed and pressure_score, but GearboxV21Decision drops those inherited safety/verification fields. A downstream consumer that uses only the v2.1 decision can therefore preserve selected_gear while losing a v2-required checkpoint, receiver ACK, verification gate or non-promotion restriction.
disagreements.required_change: v2.1 must re-project all safety-critical inherited v2 metadata or carry an immutable exact inherited-decision reference/fingerprint that downstream consumers must verify. The wrapper may add restrictions but must never remove inherited checkpoint, ACK or verification constraints.

disagreements.finding: aggregate_experience_events still str-coerces event_id. None becomes the non-empty identity string 'None', and bool/numeric/list/mapping/object values can become fabricated identities. Identity also exists only in a per-invocation seen set.
disagreements.required_change: Use one typed/versioned EventIdentity boundary plus durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry. Null/missing/non-string IDs fail closed; exact accepted replay NO_OPs; same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT; rejected claims do not reserve identity.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh remains caller-declared. Literal true can label stale secretary telemetry fresh because source, timestamp/TTL, revocation, scope, policy and installation/runtime identity are unbound.
disagreements.required_change: Consume a replay-resistant SecretarySignalEnvelope; secretary-derived pressure fields require per-field provenance/freshness so stale telemetry cannot route through the pressure side channel.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict=true only neutralizes secretary_level. It does not load, validate or enforce the actual fresh authority decision, so the executable does not prove that fresh authority wins.
disagreements.required_change: Project an exact trusted AuthorityDecisionEnvelope or fail closed; conflict handling must enforce the trusted decision rather than merely suppress secretary_level.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller-supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum sample, observation window, uncertainty or stateful enter/exit hysteresis; 1/1 can appear as 100 percent thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with precommitted support/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; all numeric thresholds remain TEST_REQUIRED.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying a safe necessary upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require paired performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; lower shift count alone is not success.

disagreements.finding: verified_progress_density is reason-only now, but because it is caller-supplied it would become self-reinforcing if connected directly to routing authority.
disagreements.required_change: Keep observational until independently derived from accepted evidence and tested against feedback-loop amplification.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still lacks mandatory exact evidence hash and trusted C/independent-verifier identity/receipt in the executable authority path. v2.1 can re-mint verified_experience_delta from raw event_kind plus event_independently_verified even when inherited v2 promotion eligibility is false.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable exact evidence identity plus trusted verifier acceptance receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity; v2.1 may only project AcceptedExperienceReceipt, never re-mint credit from raw caller fields.

disagreements.finding: Operational credit for DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND is still granted from caller event_id/event_kind without durable artifact/defect acceptance proof, allowing fake durable-progress numerator inflation without creating verified Experience.
disagreements.required_change: Require evidence-bound OperationalProgressAcceptanceReceipt plus lineage dedupe; raw caller operational events are analytics-only and authoritative credit remains zero.

disagreements.finding: Weights 5/4/3 for verified classes and 1 for operational classes are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No exact-current paired evaluation establishes speedup. Commit count, wake count, heartbeat count, window age or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/randomized crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one versioned canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency, with frozen metric definitions and equal-or-better verification/risk quality.

statistical_risks: Dropping inherited v2 safety metadata creates survivor bias in downstream routing audits: the visible selected gear may look valid while required checkpoint/ACK/gate obligations disappear from the sampled decision record.
Caller-declared secretary freshness and incomplete authority projection invalidate causal routing comparisons.
Small-n caller-supplied shift-rate estimates can false-trigger anti-thrash or chatter around the threshold.
Anti-thrash may improve gear_shift_rate while degrading cycle, closure or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density can become self-reinforcing if fed back into routing authority.
Transient event identity, same-evidence/new-ID replay, same-ID/different-binding and raw-field credit paths can inflate or suppress longitudinal Experience/progress totals.
Caller-created operational events can inflate durable-progress numerator without proof of durable work.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
Speed metrics are numerator/denominator/exposure/order/coverage sensitive and require matched paired/crossover evaluation with one frozen versioned metric manifest.
proposed_tests: GB21-INHERITED-SAFETY-METADATA-185: force v2 checkpoint_required=true, receiver_ack_required=true and NOT_PROMOTION_EVIDENCE; the v2.1 projection must retain every safety-critical field or an exact inherited-decision fingerprint/reference.
GB21-INHERITED-SAFETY-TAMPER-186: mutate inherited checkpoint/ACK/verification metadata after v2 decision creation; v2.1 projection or downstream verifier must fail closed on fingerprint mismatch.
GB21-SECRETARY-FRESHNESS-FORGE: stale RED/ORANGE plus forged freshness=true and stale numeric pressure must not route without a trusted provenance envelope.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION: fresh authority=G1/recovery with permissive caller fallback must still produce the trusted authority result.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-SMALL-N: 1/1 and 2/3 samples must not trigger calibrated anti-thrash without precommitted minimum support; threshold chatter/release must be bounded.
GB21-ANTI-THRASH-PERF-NR: lower shift rate is rejected as improvement if cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure_per_hour or recovery_latency regresses.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-NULL: forged high verified_progress_density must remain observational and cannot upshift or create Experience/progress credit.
GB21-EVENT-LINEAGE-REPLAY: same evidence under 10000 new IDs plus exact-ID restart/rollback replay must produce one authoritative acceptance only.
GB21-VERIFIED-RECEIPT-BINDING: verified event without exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier receipt yields zero authoritative verified Experience.
GB21-OPERATIONAL-RECEIPT-BINDING: 10000 raw DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND IDs without durable artifact/defect receipt yield zero authoritative operational credit.
GB21-CREDIT-NON-EQUIVALENCE: equal aggregate heuristic scores from different event mixtures must not be treated as equal capability or promotion evidence.

GB21-SPEED-PAIRED-BASELINE: sealed matched AB/BA or randomized crossover uses durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with identical metric manifest and assigned-workload coverage.

release_condition: Fresh exact-current v1+v2+v2.1 executable regression evidence exists on the same candidate bytes; historical results are not promoted as fresh PASS.

v2.1 preserves all safety-critical inherited v2 metadata or binds an immutable exact inherited-decision fingerprint/reference that downstream consumers verify; wrappers may tighten but never drop checkpoint, ACK or verification constraints.
Secretary signal provenance/freshness is replay-resistant and fresh authority is projected from an exact trusted authority decision, not caller booleans.
recent_shift_rate_ratio is derived from canonical shift history with precommitted denominator/sample/window/uncertainty and bounded hysteretic release; paired performance non-regression passes.
verified_progress_density remains observational unless independent derivation and anti-self-reinforcement tests pass.

Accepted event identity and evidence lineage are durable and rollback-resistant; exact replay NO_OPs, same evidence/new ID cannot re-credit, same-ID/different-binding is IDENTITY_CONFLICT, and rejected claims do not reserve identity.
Verified Experience requires exact evidence hash plus trusted C/independent-verifier acceptance receipt; v2.1 cannot re-mint verified credit from raw fields.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND require durable artifact/defect acceptance receipts and lineage dedupe for authoritative operational credit while remaining non-Experience.
5/4/3/1 credit values remain heuristic/analytics-only and are never capability, Trust, Identity, Personality, Governance or promotion truth.

A sealed matched paired/randomized-crossover speed study uses durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, one versioned canonical rework/rollback metric and recovery_latency with frozen metric manifest, equal assigned workload/exposure/censoring and verification/risk non-regression.
Quantum and dedicated Spirit reviews plus fresh Navigator synthesis have zero unresolved adoption-blocking vetoes before any normal A->B->C route is considered.
